label: Огород
description: A 10-sentence usage card for огород (vegetable garden).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Огород' is nominative as the subject of the existential sentence. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'за домом' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Огород' is the accusative direct object of 'любит'; as an inanimate masculine noun its accusative equals the nominative. 'Свой' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a preposition. 'Огорода' is genitive after 'около', marking proximity. 'Яблоня' is the nominative subject of 'растёт'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Огороду' is dative after 'к', marking movement toward the garden. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject of 'бегут'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after the verb. 'Огородом' is instrumental, required by 'гордимся'. 'Своим' is the agreeing masculine instrumental possessive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Огороде' is prepositional after 'в', marking where the action happens. 'Помидоры' is the nominative plural subject of 'созрели'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Огороде' is prepositional after 'в', naming where the work happens. 'Летом' is an instrumental adverb of time.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Огород' takes the accusative after 'на' to mark movement onto the plot. As an inanimate noun its accusative matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Огороды' is the nominative plural in this possession frame. 'У всех' names the owners, and 'в деревне' gives the setting.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural with 'за'. 'Огородами' is the instrumental plural after 'за', meaning to tend to the gardens. 'Соседи' is the nominative plural subject.
